functionDeclarations.name: define_subagent
functionDeclarations.description: Define a new subagent type that can then be invoked repeatedly. Subagents always have tools to research the codebase and to communicate with other agents.

Description.description: What this subagent does and when it should be used.

EnableSubagentTools.description: Grant tools to define and invoke its own subagents.

EnableWriteTools.description: Grant tools to create and edit files, and run commands.

Name.description: Unique name used to invoke the subagent.
